description: Focus areas for biographer sessions. The opening question is fixed copy; every later question is written by the biographer role. Section lists tell the person where lines from this focus usually land.

foci.title: Your story
foci.about: Where you come from: the house you grew up in, who was there, and what you learned there about closeness.
foci.opening: Let's start a long way back. Where did you grow up, and who was in the house?

foci.title: Earlier relationships
foci.about: The relationships before this one, and what each taught you.
foci.opening: Think of a relationship before this one that mattered. How did it begin, and how did it end?

foci.title: Money
foci.about: How money was handled where you grew up, how you handle it now, and what it means to you.
foci.opening: When you were a child, who handled the money at home, and how did you know when it was tight?

foci.title: Conflict and repair
foci.about: What disagreement looked like around you growing up, and what you do in one now.
foci.opening: When the adults around you disagreed when you were growing up, what did it look and sound like?

foci.title: What you're working on
foci.about: What you care about most, how your days actually go, and what you'd like to be different a year from now.
foci.opening: Picture an ordinary weekday a year from now that went the way you'd want. What are you doing differently from today?
